title: 第5章 一路逃亡第6章 身陨
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
就在鱼胜追击时候，刀锋忽至，忠老赶来，而后公子鱼被忠老一刀斩伤。
接着窦娴族人也是瞬间来到左丘辰身前，此时公子鱼咬牙忍痛起身盯着忠老，脸色很不好看，但是瞬间脸上又挂起了微笑。
“哈哈，看来鬼刀不行啊，居然没解决掉你这老头。”
公子鱼带着略带讥讽的神情说道。
而忠老几人也是看见了左丘涛的尸体，一股愤怒从心底升起...
“小主受困，麻烦忠老快解救，我兄弟二人就算死也要给老三报仇！”
左丘杰和左丘平不忍回头看去，而是直视着鱼，眼中带着必死的决然沉声道。
“流沙阵，牢笼术，这是河族王族才会的灵术看来河族与我左丘这是要不死不休啊！”
忠老看了一眼水牢笼内的左丘辰沉声道，随后单手凝聚沙土形成一把飞刀，瞬间飞出。
五行之力，相生相克，阵法有阵眼，飞刀一击而中，水牢笼破碎。，左丘辰被解救。
“我们的任务是护送小主到北宣学院，而不是轻言赴死，速速渡江！”
忠老对着被仇恨冲昏头脑的两人怒吼道，虽然自己也是恨不得斩了这诺水河族之人，但现在情况紧急，又是在河族底盘，迟则生变，唯有快点离去才是万全之策。
被解救的左丘辰看到受伤的几人和左丘涛的尸体，心如刀割，心中更是充满无尽的愧疚...
“左丘辰，如若你能活着离开平州，以后可找我报仇，哈哈！”
公子鱼没有再上前阻挡几人，而是对着左丘辰嘲讽道。
“杀我左丘族人，断我向南之路，此仇不共戴天，他日我若入灵，必斩你之首级，祭我族之英灵！”
左丘辰也是捏紧双拳对着公子鱼放出狠话，可见恨意之深。
随后忠老看着平静而又宽阔的江面，当下也不迟疑就背起左丘辰，几人会意形成包围圈撑开灵力快速踏过平江...
数日后，护送队伍眼见快走出平州边境，此刻忠老看见左丘辰脸色苍白，身体也在发抖，随后迅速喂下药丸，然后以灵力包裹左丘辰，渐渐少年额头的汗珠消失，半个时辰后左丘辰缓缓睁开眼。
醒来后的左丘辰觉得全身无力，长途赶路就算是修士也疲惫不堪，更何况身无灵力的左丘辰，好几次左丘辰都昏睡过去，昏睡后那个噩梦又出现了，每一次噩梦出现后他都感觉身体无比虚弱，像是那个噩梦会抽取他的生机一样。

“忠老，我们到哪里了？我们得速速离开平州。”
左丘辰带着疲惫的声音询问道。
“回小主，经过两日的奔波，我们已然到了红木林，穿过此林，再经过一个平原便就过了大半个平州。”
一旁左丘杰看着地图回答道，果然几人也是侧目看去，只见地图上标记着无数地名，左丘杰所指处就是红木林，在他所指的前方地图上一个巨大的黑色骷髅也是印入左丘辰的眼中。
“哪里是什么地方？为何是一个骷髅？”
“小主，这里是一处绝地，号称修士的梦魇，也叫还梦深魇，我们得绕过去。”
忠老也是沉声道，显然对还梦深魇无比恐惧，然后忠老扶起左丘辰示意众人前行。
就在此刻疲惫且放松戒备情况下，谁也没注意到，地面的树叶，身后树枝夹杂树叶已经慢慢的朝着几人缓缓袭来。
“稀疏稀疏”的声音传来，忠老立刻警觉。
“不好，躲开。”一声大喝，但还是晚了，一根红色尖木袭来，关键时刻忠老拉开左丘辰。
“噗~~”血洞出现，左丘杰被红木贯穿胸口，红色的鲜血也是喷洒在那破旧的地图上。
忠老立刻撑开灵力护盾罩住左丘辰，然后左丘平扶起左丘杰，但是后者的生机渐渐消逝，口中的鲜血不止。
“大哥！”
“快~~走。”
艰难的两个字带着血沫从左丘杰嘴中说出，然后便撒开左丘平的手。
此时狂风大作，树叶飞舞，林间所有树木皆是张牙舞爪朝着几人袭来，来不及悲伤，诡异的攻势袭来。
“草木皆兵！”
诡异的声音传来，让几人感觉到了死亡的气息，因为此刻忠老几人只能抵挡这漫天的攻势，连敌人的影子都没看见。
“你们去平原，我断后！”
左丘平悲愤，旋转长枪，然后只身挡在几人面前，左丘杰的死显然对他打击很大。

而后左丘辰便看见漫天树叶形成一个球状物包裹这左丘平，已然看不到那个如同长枪般挺拔的身影。
事已至此，忠老一咬牙随后一刀斩出，伴随着灵力扩散数十根巨木被拦腰斩断，随后几人快速逃离。
红木林之外是一片平原，穿过平原便就算离开了平州边界。
忠老开路，然后窦娴族三人带着左丘辰狂奔，拼死也要逃离这片红木林。
content_en:
Just when Yu Sheng was chasing after him, the blade suddenly came, and Zhong Lao came over. Then Gongzi Yu was slashed by Zhong Lao.
Then the Dou Xian clan members also arrived in front of Zuo Qiuchen in an instant. At this time, Young Master Yu gritted his teeth and endured the pain, stood up and stared at Mr. Zhong, his face looked very ugly, but a smile suddenly appeared on his face.
"Haha, it seems that the ghost sword is not good enough. It didn't kill you old man."
Young Master Yu said with a slightly sarcastic expression.
When Zhong Lao and others saw Zuo Qiutao's body, a surge of anger rose from the bottom of their hearts...
"The young master is trapped. Please rescue me quickly. My two brothers will avenge the third brother even if they die!"
Zuo Qiujie and Zuo Qiuping couldn't bear to look back, but looked directly at the fish, with a fatal determination in their eyes and said solemnly.
"Quicksand Formation, Cage Technique, these are spiritual techniques that only the royal family of the He Clan can master. It seems that the He Clan and I, Zuoqiu, are fighting to the death!"
Zhonglao glanced at Zuo Qiuchen in the water cage and said solemnly, then condensed the sand with one hand to form a flying knife, which flew out instantly.
The power of the five elements is mutually reinforcing and inhibiting each other. The formation has an eye. The flying knife hits with one strike and the water cage is shattered. , Zuo Qiuchen was rescued.
"Our mission is to escort the young master to Beixuan Academy, not to die lightly and cross the river quickly!"
Zhong Lao roared at the two people who were overwhelmed by hatred. Although he also wanted to kill this person from the Nuoshui River Clan, the situation was urgent now and he was in the He Clan. Things would change later. The only safe way was to leave quickly.
Zuo Qiuchen, who was rescued, saw the injured people and Zuo Qiutao's body, his heart was cut by a knife, and his heart was filled with endless guilt...
"Zuo Qiuchen, if you can leave Pingzhou alive, you can seek revenge from me in the future, haha!"
Gongziyu did not step forward to stop the others, but mocked Zuo Qiuchen.
"Kill my Zuoqiu tribesmen and cut off my way to the south. This hatred is irreconcilable. If I become a spirit one day, I will behead you and sacrifice it to the heroic spirit of my tribe!"
Zuo Qiuchen also clenched his fists and uttered harsh words towards Mr. Yu, showing the depth of his hatred.
Then Zhonglao looked at the calm and wide river surface, and without hesitation he carried Zuo Qiuchen on his back. The few of them knew how to form a circle and used their spiritual power to quickly cross the Pingjiang River...
A few days later, the escort team was about to leave the Pingzhou border. At this moment, Zhonglao saw Zuo Qiuchen's face was pale and his body was shaking. He quickly fed the pills, and then wrapped Zuo Qiuchen with spiritual power. The sweat on the young man's forehead gradually disappeared. Half an hour later, Zuo Qiuchen slowly opened his eyes.
After waking up, Zuo Qiuchen felt weak all over. Even a monk would be exhausted after a long journey, not to mention Zuo Qiuchen, who had no spiritual power. Zuo Qiuchen fell asleep several times. After falling asleep, the nightmare appeared again. Every time the nightmare appeared, he felt extremely weak, as if the nightmare would drain his life.
"Lao Zhong, where are we? We have to leave Pingzhou quickly."
Zuo Qiuchen asked with a tired voice.
"Back to my master, after two days of running around, we have arrived at the redwood forest. After passing through this forest and passing through a plain, we have crossed most of Pingzhou."
Zuo Qiujie looked at the map and replied. Sure enough, several people also looked sideways and saw countless place names marked on the map. The place Zuo Qiujie was pointing was the redwood forest. A huge black skull on the map ahead of him was also imprinted in Zuo Qiuchen's eyes.
"Where is what place? Why a skeleton?"
"My lord, this is a deserted place, known as the monk's nightmare, also known as the Deep Nightmare. We have to go around it."
Mr. Zhong also said in a deep voice, obviously extremely afraid of returning to the deep nightmare. Then Mr. Zhong helped Zuo Qiuchen and motioned for everyone to move forward.
At this moment, when they were tired and relaxed, no one noticed that the leaves on the ground and the branches behind them mixed with leaves were slowly coming towards a few people.
The sound of "sparse and sparse" came, and Mr. Zhong immediately became alert.
"No, get away." A loud shout came, but it was still too late.A red sharp wood struck, and Zhonglao pulled Zuo Qiuchen away at the critical moment.
"Poof~~" A blood hole appeared, Zuo Qiujie was penetrated by the redwood in the chest, and red blood was sprayed on the worn map.
Zhonglao immediately opened his spiritual shield to cover Zuo Qiuchen, and then Zuo Qiuping helped Zuo Qiujie up, but the latter's vitality gradually disappeared and blood continued to flow from his mouth.
"Brother!"
"Hurry~~ Let's go."
The word "hardship" came out of Zuo Qiujie's mouth with blood foam, and then he let go of Zuo Qiuping's hand.
At this time, strong winds were blowing, leaves were flying, and all the trees in the forest were baring their teeth and claws to attack a few people. There was no time to grieve, and a strange offensive came.
"Both trees and grass are soldiers!"
The strange sound came, making several people feel the breath of death, because at this moment Zhong Lao and the others could only resist the overwhelming offensive, and they did not even see the shadow of the enemy.
"You go to the plains, I will cut off the queen!"
Zuo Qiuping was filled with grief and anger, twirling his spear, and then stood alone in front of several people. Zuo Qiujie's death obviously hit him hard.
Then Zuo Qiuchen saw the leaves all over the sky forming a ball-shaped object surrounding Zuo Qiuping, and the tall figure like a spear was no longer visible.
At this point, Zhonglao gritted his teeth and then slashed out with his sword. As the spiritual power spread, dozens of giant trees were cut in half, and then several people quickly fled.
Beyond the redwood forest is a plain, and once you cross the plain, you leave the border of Pingzhou.
Zhonglao opened the way, and then the three Dou Xian clan members took Zuo Qiuchen and ran wildly, desperately trying to escape from the redwood forest.
